WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(state_county_province, '(no state)') AS state_province,
         COUNT(*) AS customer_count
  FROM Customers
  GROUP BY COALESCE(state_county_province, '(no state)')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT state_province,
         customer_count,
         1.0 * customer_count / SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
),
benchmarks AS (
  SELECT *,
         AVG(share) OVER () AS average_state_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - average_state_share) AS average_amount_above_average
FROM benchmarks
WHERE share > average_state_share
